plan.title: sec(authz): close UAT residual archive/alt-downloaders + kill-switch plant; harden triage-cache symlink follow

narratives.Description: AppSec @ 333602b9: under active UAT, archive extractors and alternate downloaders still classify empty and fail-open enough to plant .deft/authz grants or a regular-file .deft-directive-disable kill-switch. Separately, triage-cache JSONL writers follow in-tree leaf symlinks and can corrupt tracked files.
narratives.UserStory: As a Directive operator running UAT with Shell hooks, I want residual archive and alternate-downloader writes into authz or kill-switch paths to fail closed, so that agents cannot bypass Wave-1 UAT or disable Directive via those bins.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Extend packages/core/src/authz/classify.ts write-bin/dest parsing for archive extractors and alt downloaders (tar/unzip/rclone/axel/fetch/socat/lftp/7z/bsdtar etc.) targeting .deft/authz or kill-switch basenames; under UAT fail closed on unclassifiable write-shaped Shell. Harden packages/core/src/triage triage-cache append (candidates-log) with assertWriteTargetSafe/containedWrite so leaf symlinks are not followed into tracked files. Port AppSec PoCs to failing Vitest then green; keep #3206/#3213 regressions green. CHANGELOG Unreleased security note without exploit cookbook. Stay in authz + triage writer paths.
narratives.Overview: sec(authz): close UAT residual archive/alt-downloaders + kill-switch plant; harden triage-cache symlink follow
narratives.NonGoals: Out of scope bullets from issue body.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Four acceptance items cover product fix, regressions, and CHANGELOG.

narrative.Acceptance: Given active UAT and shell commands that extract or download into .deft/authz/grants, when classify+decideHook run, the op is settings/write-shaped fail-closed (not empty allow).
Given active UAT and alt-downloader/archive targeting .deft-directive-disable as a regular file, when classified, decision is fail-closed settings (not allow).
Given candidates.jsonl is a leaf symlink to an in-tree tracked file, when triage append runs, write is refused or contained so the target tracked file is not corrupted.

items.title: Triage-cache append refuses leaf symlink follow

narrative.Acceptance: Given Vitest fixtures for residual PoCs and #3206/#3213 regressions, when suites run, all pass; CHANGELOG cites #3245 without exploit detail.
